messages:
jordan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on security/compliance. Customers asked for a short, customer-ready summary covering: SOC2/ISO status, VPC private control plane (peering/endpoints/SSO), audit log fields & retention, and BYOK key rotation. Who can own bullet answers?

sec-bot: Slides + compliance tracker uploaded: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/compliance. Office-hours RSVP: https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours.

nina: Short bullets: SOC2 Type II audit window targeted Oct-Nov 2026; controls in place by Aug 2026. ISO 27001 readiness assessment planned Q3 2026; certification target H1 2027. We'll publish controls mapping next week.

cole: Audit logs: v1 schema emits ts, service, model_id, model_version, request_id, route, token_in, token_out, latency_ms, actor_id. Hosted default: prompt_text redacted/truncated and 90-day retention. Private: full exports to customer buckets; retention controlled by customer. Example: ```{"ts":"2026-07-20T18:03:12Z","service":"inference","model_id":"rwd-13b","model_version":"v2.2","request_id":"req_0G7H"}```

infra-lee: VPC/private control plane beta: mid-July for small cohort. Features in beta: VPC endpoints, cross-account peering (IAM role trust), and SSO (SAML/OIDC). Beta docs will include peering checklist and required IAM materials.

frank: BYOK/KMS: Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) now. Envelope encryption used. Key rotation supported via customer KMS + our rekey API; rotation guide and runbook coming. HSM-backed BYOK (FIPS) planned as limited alpha in Q4. Note: rotating keys can require rewraps for long-lived KV caches.

jordan: Action items: 1) Publish one-pager for sales + FAQ (owner: @nina), 2) Publish audit-log schema + ingest recipes (owner: @cole), 3) VPC beta checklist (owner: @infra-lee), 4) BYOK rotation playbook (owner: @frank), 5) Schedule office hours and convert thread to checklist (sec-bot). Please post ETAs.

nina: ETA: sales one-pager + FAQ by 2026-06-30.

cole: ETA: audit-log schema + sample exports by 2026-06-25.

infra-lee: ETA: VPC checklist by 2026-07-05.

frank: ETA: BYOK rotation guide draft by 2026-07-10.

sec-bot: Tasks created: [sales-onepager], [audit-log-schema], [vpc-beta-checklist], [byok-rotation-playbook], [office-hours]. Will ping owners tomorrow at 09:00 UTC.

jordan: Thanks all. If any customers need immediate answers DM the owners and we'll triage in office hours.
